FIELDS.NAME: Sew Chic Tailoring
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: Jane Doe, Manager, Sew Chic Tailoring, (555) 123-4567
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sew Chic Tailoring specializes in custom garment creation and alterations for individual clients, offering personalized services that include clothing repairs, adjustments, and bespoke attire. Our operations focus on maintaining low hazard exposure while providing high-quality craftsmanship. We operate by appointment for customer fittings, ensuring a controlled flow of clients and reduced liability risk. Our tailored services also extend to prom and wedding attire, with an emphasis on managing high-value inventory. We pride ourselves on attention to detail and customer satisfaction, fostering long-term relationships with our clientele through exceptional service and skilled tailoring.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 01/10/2023, a heavy storm caused water damage to our shop, affecting our sewing machines and fabric inventory. The total estimated loss is $1,500. The claim has been submitted to our insurance provider and is currently under review.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Saturday, 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM; closed on Sunday.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Standard safe with a class 3 security grading and UL-rated locking mechanism for secure storage of cash, documents, and valuable materials.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security personnel on-site during business hours.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Sew Chic Tailoring does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials in its operations, as it focuses on custom garment creation and alterations with low hazard exposure.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Sew Chic Tailoring does not sponsor athletic teams as our primary focus is on custom garment creation and alterations for individual clients.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Subcontractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are typically checked by the management to ensure proper documentation and risk transfer.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Sew Chic Tailoring has not been indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property. Our business is focused on providing quality tailoring services with a commitment to ethical practices.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Sew Chic Tailoring has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years. All insurance matters have been handled without issue.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Sew Chic Tailoring does not lease employees to or from other employers, as our operations are fully staffed internally to provide personalized services to our clients.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – Sew Chic Tailoring currently does not carry Workers' Compensation insurance, as all operations are managed internally with a focus on personalized services and low hazard exposure.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Sew Chic Tailoring operates another business called Sew Chic Custom Fabrics, LLC, which complements our tailoring services.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Sew Chic Tailoring does not have any other insurance policies with this company. Our current policy is the only coverage in place.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Sew Chic Tailoring is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations strictly focus on custom garment creation and alterations for individual clients, ensuring a personalized service without engaging in manufacturing processes.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Sew Chic Tailoring does not rent or loan equipment to others, focusing solely on providing customized tailoring services to individual clients. This helps maintain our operational integrity and minimize liability risks.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Sew Chic Tailoring has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. The business maintains a solid financial standing and focuses on providing exceptional tailoring services.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Sew Chic Tailoring does not have exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as our operations focus solely on custom garment creation and alterations with low hazard exposure. We do not engage in any activities that involve these materials.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Sew Chic Tailoring does not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations are focused on custom garment creation and alterations, which minimizes risk in this area. We prioritize maintaining a safe and compliant environment for our clients and staff.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Sew Chic Tailoring has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The business maintains a strong focus on ethical practices and employee relations.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Sew Chic Tailoring has no uncorrected fire code violations. We maintain compliance with all local fire codes and prioritize safety in our operations.
